`class RasterResourceDecoder`<br/>
**Implements:** [`IResourceDecoder`](/reference/resources/iresourcedecoder/)<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.resource.decoder.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [RasterResourceDecoder.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/resource/decoder/impl/RasterResourceDecoder.java)

Decodes a still image, PNG, JPEG, BMP, still WebP and the other formats of the bundled image readers, into one texture.

## Description

[`ResourceFormat`](/reference/resources/resourceformat/) picks it for any file that no other format recognizes.
The transparent pixels take the color of their opaque neighbours, so that the edges of a scaled image do not darken.

- [Custom formats](/use/learn/going-further/custom-formats/)

<a id="RasterResourceDecoder-method-decode"></a>

### decode

`void decode(ResourceData resource)` 

Reads the image and sets the size and the pixels of the data.
Throws `UncheckedIOException` when the asset cannot be read, and `IllegalArgumentException` when no reader can decode it.
